description: This file defines a React functional component named DeviceTable, which renders a table of devices with features like search, sorting, and actions (view, edit, delete, ping). It manages internal state for search and sorting, and references external components and types.

methods.name: DeviceTable
methods.description: React functional component that renders a device table with search, sorting, and action buttons.

methods.name: toggleSort
methods.description: Toggles the sorting direction for a given column.

methods.name: sortIndicator
methods.description: Returns the sort indicator symbol based on current sort state.
